title: Distribute decisions within explicit boundaries
text: The book’s decentralisation guidance pairs local decision-making with executive guardrails, clear decision lanes, a changed coaching role for managers and removal of cross-team blockers. Distributed work therefore does not mean that each team invents its own risk policy or loses access to shared expertise.
qualification: Management framework with illustrative cases; not a causal validation of a single organisational design.
